scripts.build: npm run build --prefix packages/mcu-schema && npm run build --prefix packages/mcu-language && npm run build --prefix packages/mcu-geometry && npm run build --prefix packages/mcu-lsp && npm run build --prefix extension && npm run copy-extension-assets
scripts.copy-extension-assets: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('path');const d=p.join('extension','server');fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(p.join('packages','mcu-lsp','dist','server.js'),p.join(d,'server.js'));const v=p.join('extension','vendor','mcu-schema');fs.rmSync(v,{recursive:true,force:true});fs.cpSync(p.join('packages','mcu-schema','dist'),v,{recursive:true});const vl=p.join('extension','vendor','mcu-language');fs.rmSync(vl,{recursive:true,force:true});fs.cpSync(p.join('packages','mcu-language','dist'),vl,{recursive:true});const sb=p.join(vl,'schemaBridge.js'); if(fs.existsSync(sb)){ let t=fs.readFileSync(sb,'utf8'); t=t.replace(/require\(\"\.\.\/\.\.\/mcu-schema\/dist\//g,'require(\"../mcu-schema/'); fs.writeFileSync(sb,t);} const vg=p.join('extension','vendor','mcu-geometry');fs.mkdirSync(vg,{recursive:true});const mp=p.join('packages','mcu-geometry','dist','meshPreview.js'); if (fs.existsSync(mp)) fs.copyFileSync(mp,p.join(vg,'meshPreview.js')); console.log('LSP + mcu-schema + mcu-language(dist) + mcu-geometry (meshPreview) copied to extension/');"
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix packages/mcu-schema && npm run test --prefix packages/mcu-language && npm run test --prefix packages/mcu-geometry && npm run test --prefix packages/mcu-lsp && npm run test --prefix extension
